origin.description: Estimate the Shannon entropy from the distance to the k nearest neighbors.
origin.details: The result has one value per neighbor count from 1 to k. digamma of a positive integer is -euler_gamma plus the harmonic number.

translation.description: entropy is digamma(n) - digamma(1:k) plus the volume term and the mean log neighbor distance.
translation.details: The result has one value per neighbor count from 1 to k. digamma of a positive integer is -euler_gamma plus the harmonic number.
